mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_habit (member_id, name, category_user_id, status, color, frequency, start_date, is_public, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{name}, #{categoryUserId}, #{status}, #{color}, #{frequency}, #{startDate}, CASE WHEN #{isPublic} THEN '1' ELSE '0' END, NOW(), NOW() )
INSERT INTO user_habit_schedule (user_habit_id, day_of_week, times_per_week, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userHabitId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{timesPerWeek}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT uh.id, uh.name, uh.color, c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, cu.emoji, uh.frequency, uh.status, uh.frozen_until, uhs.day_of_week, hh.status as today_status, uh.start_date, uh.is_public FROM user_habit uh LEFT JOIN category_user cu ON uh.category_user_id = cu.id LEFT JOIN category c ON cu.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user_habit_schedule uhs ON uh.id = uhs.user_habit_id LEFT JOIN habit_history hh ON uh.id = hh.user_habit_id AND hh.check_date = #{date} WHERE uh.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY uh.id DESC, uhs.day_of_week ASC

SELECT uh.id, uh.name, uh.color, c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, cu.emoji, uh.frequency, uh.status, uh.frozen_until, uhs.day_of_week, hh.status as today_status, uh.is_public FROM user_habit uh LEFT JOIN category_user cu ON uh.category_user_id = cu.id LEFT JOIN category c ON cu.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user_habit_schedule uhs ON uh.id = uhs.user_habit_id LEFT JOIN habit_history hh ON uh.id = hh.user_habit_id AND hh.check_date = CURDATE() WHERE uh.id = #{userHabitId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO habit_history (user_habit_id, check_date, status, created_at) VALUES (#{userHabitId}, #{checkDate}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM habit_history WHERE user_habit_id = #{userHabitId} AND check_date = #{checkDate}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_habit_id, check_date, status, created_at FROM habit_history WHERE user_habit_id = #{userHabitId} AND check_date = #{checkDate}
SELECT id, member_id, name, category_user_id, status, frozen_until, frequency, start_date, is_public, created_at, updated_at FROM user_habit WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_habit SET status = #{status}, frozen_until = #{frozenUntil}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT check_date FROM habit_history WHERE user_habit_id = #{userHabitId} AND status = ('DONE','HEART') ORDER BY check_date DESC
